Text:
One single continuous photograph — no panels, grids, or split frames.

Use the uploaded photo as the exact base composition. The street in the source
is empty — populate it with the people and vehicles specified below. Remove all
modern businesses, logos, brands, storefront names, banners, advertisements, and
signage visible in the source image.

PRESERVE (must match source exactly)
- camera: aerial, facing street, fov 90
- highway road, 1-lane, asphalt
- sidewalks absent, curbs absent
- driveways: right; parking: none
- commercial building at center, 1 story, wood, brick, metal, pitched roof, shallow setback
- utilities: power lines, utility poles
- landscape: bare soil
- immutable elements: mountain
Keep this location instantly recognizable.

OUTPUT FORMAT
Create a TRUE 9:16 vertical portrait. Expand the SAME scene naturally above
(sky) and below (street/pavement) as canvas extension — do not stretch or
distort the source geometry.

TRANSFORM TO 2005
Post-9/11 era. A 2005 gas station — big multi-island canopy, card readers at every pump, LED price sign, and a convenience store doing most of the business.

CONDITION: busy — customers present, high activity, all pumps in use

PERIOD DETAILS
- large convenience store with energy-drink and phone-card ads in the glass
- coin-operated air machine near the back of the lot
- price sign showing gas around $2.30
- main sign: "Arco" branded gas station — Arco pole sign with price display and Arco colors on the canopy fascia
- window signs: 'ANY SIZE FOUNTAIN DRINK 99¢', 'CAR WASH $6'
- 'NO SMOKING — TURN OFF ENGINE' decals on each pump
- trash cans with paper-towel dispensers between the pumps
Typography: clean sans-serif, polished brand identities.
Sign text is only what appears in quotes — do not turn other words from this prompt into signage.

PEOPLE
EXACTLY 4 people TOTAL: 2 near sidewalk (largest, foreground), 1 opposite sidewalk mid-block, 1 distant, far end of block. Grouped in pairs, threes, and singles.
- a man talking on a flip phone while leaning against his SUV as it fuels
- a clerk restocking the window display inside
- a couple taking photos with a digital camera
Clothing: men in frosted tips hair, graphic tees; women in low-rise jeans, velour tracksuits. Fashion palette: denim, pink, white. No posing or eye contact. All people stay on sidewalks, at storefronts, or beside parked vehicles — never standing, sitting, or walking in the road or driving lanes. Any customer activity at the pumps happens next to a parked vehicle — no one refuels without a car present.

VEHICLES
EXACTLY 4 period vehicles, all different:
- 2001-2007 Dodge Grand Caravan — family minivan, rounded — black
- 2002-2006 Toyota Camry — smooth conservative mid-size — silver
- 2004-2008 Pontiac Grand Prix — sporty sedan plastic cladding — gold
- 2001-2007 Ford Escape — compact boxy SUV — dark red
Parked with gaps; no vehicle newer than 2005.
Parked vehicles hug the curb — parallel, each facing its lane's direction; none sideways, diagonal, or against traffic. Keep at least one full driving lane clear each way for through traffic.
PLACEMENT: the first one parked on the LEFT side near the corner; the rest parked on the RIGHT side. No vehicle in the same spot as any other era.

ENVIRONMENT
- road markings: yellow center line, white edge lines, turn arrows
- utilities: overhead power lines standard, cable and fiber lines on poles appearing

TREES
- deciduous tree at left: very young sapling
- deciduous tree at right: very young sapling
- deciduous tree at background: young tree, thin trunk
Tree sizes MUST follow this specification even where they differ from the source photo.

PHOTOGRAPHIC STYLE
COLOR photograph — early digital camera or Kodak/Fuji consumer film look.
Color: neutral tones. Grain: low grain, early digital noise in shadows.
Photorealistic — NOT black-and-white, no HDR.

PRIVACY
Blur all faces and license plates.
SelectedVehicles: 2001-2007 Dodge Grand Caravan — family minivan, rounded
2004-2008 Pontiac Grand Prix — sporty sedan plastic cladding
